clean_body: [] Twin Lakes-Elkhorn Crest by Robin Coen Dear Peter, While it may be April Fool’s, we’re not fooling around. OLCV’s Annual Celebration for the Environment is on Friday, April 24th, and we’re giving away a once-in-a-lifetime vacation package! Purchase a raffle ticket for just $100 for your chance to win! [] One lucky winner will get to “choose their own adventure” from three incredible packages. Cabo San Lucas – Luxury Oceanfront Escape Relax at the Grand Solmar Pacific Dunes Resort Golf & Spa, where desert dunes meet turquoise waters. Enjoy oceanfront studio views, golden beaches, world-class golf, spa indulgence, and vibrant marina nights. [] Jackson Hole – Alpine Adventure Hit the slopes with full-day lift tickets, then choose an Elk Refuge Sleigh Ride or a craft Distillery Tour. Cozy up afterward at The Lodge or Rockwell Inn for rustic charm, fireplaces, and iconic Teton views included. [] Grand Canyon – Stargazing Sky Dome Retreat Sleep beneath the stars in a luxury Sky Dome just minutes from the South Rim. Enjoy panoramic windows, rain-shower bathrooms, and epic sunrise/sunset views at the perfect base for your national park adventure. [] Click here for more information about the packages! [] The best part is that every ticket supports OLCV’s work to protect Oregon’s climate and environment and puts you one step closer to the vacation of your dreams. Don’t wait to get your tickets before time runs out! [] Buy your raffle ticket [] We’ll choose the lucky winner at the event on Friday, April 24th, in Portland. If you haven’t already bought your ticket, I hope you’ll join us for a night you won’t forget, full of celebration, inspiration, great food, and great company! In today's fast-paced world we are inundated with advertisements for on-the go snacks and beverages. Advertisers have mastered the art of capturing the attention of children to increase their sales even more. In fact, many snacks and drinks are marketed solely to children, promising energy, refreshment, and even excitement. However, just like snacks, these popular drinks are often packed with ingredients which can be detrimental to childrens' health. Energy drinks, sugary sodas or Slurpees, pre-workout drinks, and Frappuccinos, might seem like harmless treats, but the ingredients in these can contribute to the development of type 2 diabetes and insulin resistance. Insulin resistance is a condition where the body's cells no longer respond to insulin, a hormone that regulates blood sugar.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.88XAEpihM_-hPn4dEJql0yr_dSUbNTO4GdDZCOOXhHk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=192881982)
Energy drinks, loaded with sugar and caffeine, are often marketed to youth, with the promise to boost energy, alertness, and performance. These can have serious consequences for young, developing bodies. The excessive caffeine in energy drinks can lead to an irregular heartbeat, high blood pressure, and anxiety. The high sugar content may lead to weight gain and an increased risk of developing type 2 diabetes over time. Consuming these regularly can also promote a cycle of sugar and caffeine addiction, making it harder for kids to choose healthier alternatives.
Soda drinks, a staple in our American diet, are very high in sugar content. This is a significant contributor to childhood obesity and chronic inflammation, which is at the core of every modern-day disease. These drinks are not only high in sugar, but typically contain high-fructose corn syrup, which is an artificially produced sweetener, and even more harmful than regular table sugar to the body. It leads to rapid spikes in blood sugar levels. The constant surge of sugar intake can lead to insulin resistance.
Pre-workout drinks, often promoted to enhance athletic performance, can be hazardous to kids as well. These drinks often contain high levels of caffeine, artificial stimulants, and unregulated substances. The caffeine can elevate blood pressure and increase the risk of heart problems. Additionally, the artificial ingredients present can disrupt the body's natural metabolic processes, potentially leading to insulin resistance and diabetes. For kids, these products can be especially dangerous, as their bodies are still developing and more susceptible to the negative effects.
Artificially sweetened drinks, or "zero sugar" drinks, which are marketed as a healthier alternative to those containing sugar, pose their own health risks. Artificial sweeteners like aspartame, sucralose, and saccharin, can have an impact on metabolic health. Some studies suggest that artificial sweeteners have the potential to disrupt the body's ability to regulate blood sugar, leading to insulin resistance. Additionally, consuming these drinks contributes to a preference for overly-sweet tastes, making it challenging for children to appreciate the natural sweetness of fruit and other whole foods.
Frappuccinos, the popular coffee-based beverages customized with flavored syrups, contain an alarming amount of hidden calories and sugar. Marketing is often targeted towards teenagers and the portion sizes are excessive. The sugar content in a single Frappuccino is likely to exceed a child's recommended daily sugar intake significantly. Overconsumption of these high-sugar treats can lead to obesity, insulin resistance, and poor metabolic health.
At Fast.Eat.Live. our coaches educate our clients about the many alternatives to these popular drinks, both for themselves and for their children. It's essential for parents and caregivers to be aware of the potential health risks associated with these beverages and to encourage children to make healthier drink choices. Instead of indulging in these drinks regularly, our best advice is to enjoy them as a rare or special treat, as if they were a birthday cake. Promoting the intake of basic water, coconut water, electrolyte sports drinks (sweetened with natural sugar alternatives like stevia or monk fruit), probiotic beverages like Kombucha, or water kefir is a crucial step in safeguarding the health of the next generation. Visit our website for healthy drink suggestions to provide your children with better alternatives. ◆

| | **BREAKING: “Trump signs sweeping order attacking mail-in voting” _—Democracy Docket_** We knew this was on the horizon. Donald Trump is desperate to avoid historic losses for Republicans this November. But instead of working to earn votes by doing things the American people support, he’s racing to rig the rules. That’s why he just signed a blatantly unconstitutional executive order trying to restrict mail voting. And that’s why we have to keep fighting back for equal access to the ballot box. [**If you’re outraged and able to push back with a donation right now, please chip in to help prevent voter suppression, electing voting rights champions, and fight for free and fair elections. Your support helps make sure we’re able to respond to new threats like this executive order at a moment’s notice**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128591448/611715291/-1370916003?refcode=emm_ff_20260401_T1_RRTrumpEO_v1s3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5Yjg0Nzg3Yy1mZjJkLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Cbky5HdcfshvKD6LXRDynshYw6Ha8rcwlDikGzn-OwQ=). Trump’s order sets out to create lists of citizens eligible to vote in each state, mandate that mail ballots only be sent to voters on approved lists, prioritize investigations into ballots sent to ineligible voters, and threaten to cut off federal funding for states that don’t comply with the new requirements. **Here are a few key points you can bring up to highlight the absurdity — and the autocratic origins — of this order:**
* **Just days ago, Trump himself voted by mail** in Florida. Now he wants to restrict that same right for millions of Americans.
* Three federal judges already blocked provisions of a similar Trump order trying to change how elections are run — because **presidents don’t have the power to do this.**
* Naturally,**this tracks back to Putin.** Last summer, Trump declared that he’d try to ban mail voting after hearing from Putin that supposedly “it’s impossible to have mail-in voting and have an honest election.”
* But **mail voting fraud is virtually nonexistent** — only 0.000043% of all mail ballots cast according to a Brookings Institution Report. And when Georgia’s Republican Secretary of State audited 8.2 million voters in 2024, he only found a 0.002% rate of possible irregularities.

Trump’s in for a tough court fight. And we know what we need to do: stay laser-focused on our mission to make sure the American people are free to make their voices heard this November. clean_body: Here’s what you need to know: | | | BREAKING: “Trump signs sweeping order attacking mail-in voting” —Democracy Docket We knew this was on the horizon. Donald Trump is desperate to avoid historic losses for Republicans this November. But instead of working to earn votes by doing things the American people support, he’s racing to rig the rules. That’s why he just signed a blatantly unconstitutional executive order trying to restrict mail voting. And that’s why we have to keep fighting back for equal access to the ballot box. =. Trump’s order sets out to create lists of citizens eligible to vote in each state, mandate that mail ballots only be sent to voters on approved lists, prioritize investigations into ballots sent to ineligible voters, and threaten to cut off federal funding for states that don’t comply with the new requirements. Here are a few key points you can bring up to highlight the absurdity — and the autocratic origins — of this order: Just days ago, Trump himself voted by mail in Florida. Now he wants to restrict that same right for millions of Americans. Three federal judges already blocked provisions of a similar Trump order trying to change how elections are run — because presidents don’t have the power to do this. Naturally,this tracks back to Putin. Last summer, Trump declared that he’d try to ban mail voting after hearing from Putin that supposedly “it’s impossible to have mail-in voting and have an honest election.” But mail voting fraud is virtually nonexistent — only 0.000043% of all mail ballots cast according to a Brookings Institution Report. And when Georgia’s Republican Secretary of State audited 8.2 million voters in 2024, he only found a 0.002% rate of possible irregularities. Trump’s in for a tough court fight. And we know what we need to do: stay laser-focused on our mission to make sure the American people are free to make their voices heard this November. =. body:
Grassroots or guided? Inside the ‘No Kings’ protests in Colorado
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
April 1st is here—so if a headline today sounds too outrageous to be true... just give it a second. In 2026, that’s not always a reliable test. 😅 (Although, we can promise, there's no fake news here!)
Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). And also, check out our [deep-dive video of the day](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on this past weekend's "grassroots" No Kings protests in Colorado.
Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Lawmakers are confronting a $1 billion to $1.5 billion budget shortfall, putting programs like the [senior homestead tax exemption at risk](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while the [state’s Medicaid chief has resigned](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) amid bipartisan concerns over mismanagement and rising costs in the now-largest budget program.

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** A judge [allowed a lawsuit against Gov. Jared Polis](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) over an ICE subpoena dispute to proceed, while Democrats finalized a contentious primary field with [Phil Weiser securing about 90% support at assembly](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as top candidates bypassed the process. [“No Kings” protests billed as grassroots](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) are facing scrutiny over national coordination and funding, and worsening drought—[now affecting over 90% of the state](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)—could bring water restrictions and higher rates as [broader climate policy debates continue](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Vice President JD Vance has called for a White House review into [allegations that Rep. Ilhan Omar committed immigration fraud](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while major corporations are pulling back from DEI benchmarks, with participation in a leading index [dropping 65% from 377 companies in 2025 to 131 in 2026](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Grassroots or guided? Inside the ‘No Kings’ protests in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
A large crowd gathered at the Colorado State Capitol on Saturday before marching through downtown Denver — the third installment of a movement its organizers describe on their national website as a grassroots uprising, “spreading from small towns to city centers and across every community determined to defend democracy.” Denver was one of many across the state.
No Kings has promoted itself consistently as decentralized and leaderless since it launched in 2025, built on the energy of ordinary Americans acting on their own.
State records, financial filings, and an internal organizing document tell a more complicated story.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[When “Protecting Seniors” Meets Fiscal Reality: A Self-Inflicted Crisis](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY REP. KEN DEGRAAF, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Senior tax relief at risk amid budget shortfall:** Colorado’s senior homestead exemption—designed to protect fixed-income homeowners—is now competing for limited general fund dollars as the state faces a $1–$1.5 billion deficit, making it one of the largest potential cuts.
* **Critics say policy priorities drove current situation:** The commentary argues repeated efforts to strengthen the exemption were rejected as too costly, while spending in other areas—particularly energy infrastructure—has expanded, shifting priorities away from seniors and veterans.
* **Debate highlights broader fiscal tradeoffs under TABOR:** With TABOR surplus funds no longer reliably covering the program, the exemption must now compete in the budget, underscoring how changes to fiscal policy and spending decisions can leave even widely supported programs vulnerable.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|

**[As climate costs rise, will Colorado follow New York’s “breathing room” playbook?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY CORY GAINES, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Rising costs prompt “breathing room” debate on climate mandates:** The commentary points to New York officials acknowledging their climate policies may have set overly aggressive standards, raising questions about whether Colorado could face similar pressures as costs increase.
* **Critics warn policies rely heavily on federal funding:** The piece argues Colorado has tied major energy and climate initiatives to federal subsidies, masking true costs and creating long-term dependence on shifting national policies.
* **Accountability debate centers on state-level decisions:** The author contends that rising costs and potential policy rollbacks stem from choices made by state leaders, not external factors, urging voters to scrutinize long-term fiscal impacts.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY TOM ANTHONY | COMMENTARY | MARCH 30** _My great grandpa excavated Federal Blvd and Colfax with mules and a scraper, his dad having been on the third wagon train into Denver in 1858. For many years I owned and developed Denver property out of the commitment: “Sustainable Cities People Love,” my company motto._
__
**[Colorado collected $3.1 billion in marijuana taxes. Here’s how much actually reaches schools.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | MARCH 30** _When Colorado voters said yes to legal marijuana back in 2012, schools were a big part of the pitch. More than a decade in, the state has collected over 3.1 billion dollars in tax revenue. So where does it all go?_

**[Self-Governance Is Not a Spectator Sport](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY REP. KEN DEGRAAF | STATE | MARCH 30** _"When you want to help people, you tell them the truth. When you want to help yourself, you tell them what they want to hear.” — Thomas Sowell. Here is the truth: if citizens want constitutional, accountable representation in Colorado, they must invest in it._ __

As the observation goes, the Roman system limited the Senate’s direct lawmaking power in part because “old men dislike change”—a critique some commentators argue still applies to today’s institution and its resistance to reform.

name: Emily Randall
subject: This will cost lives
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Emily Randall for Congress
body:
| My heart hurts, Peter. Yesterday, in an 8-1 decision, the Supreme Court overturned a life-saving ban on conversion “therapy” in Colorado. **Yesterday. On Trans Day of Visibility.** For those of you who aren’t familiar, conversion therapy is the entirely medically unsubstantiated practice of trying to transform queer and trans people out of their identities. To put it plainly:**it’s evil. It’s not science; it has a zero percent success rate, and it ruins lives.** I know and love people who have survived conversion therapy — who were forced as children to meet with these “therapists” and live forever with the pain of the hurt and doubt they instilled in them. And the ones I know are the ones who survived. Many do not. **Conversion therapy costs lives — this decision will cost lives.** This is a practice that takes the lives of youth who have been sold the lie that there is something deeply wrong with them on account of their queerness. A House and Senate majority is becoming more and more critical by the day. This decision puts Washington’s ban at legal risk. Along with our youth. I will never stop fighting for queer and trans people of all ages. **This fight is far from over.** – Emily | | Emily Randall is proud to represent Washington’s 6th District in Congress. She grew up in a working-class Union household in Port Orchard and was the first in her family to attend college. After serving in the State Senate and passing nearly 200 bills, Emily made history in 2024 as the first queer Latina elected to Congress. clean_body: | My heart hurts, Peter. Yesterday, in an 8-1 decision, the Supreme Court overturned a life-saving ban on conversion “therapy” in Colorado. Yesterday. On Trans Day of Visibility. For those of you who aren’t familiar, conversion therapy is the entirely medically unsubstantiated practice of trying to transform queer and trans people out of their identities. To put it plainly:it’s evil. It’s not science; it has a zero percent success rate, and it ruins lives. I know and love people who have survived conversion therapy — who were forced as children to meet with these “therapists” and live forever with the pain of the hurt and doubt they instilled in them. And the ones I know are the ones who survived. Many do not. Conversion therapy costs lives — this decision will cost lives. This is a practice that takes the lives of youth who have been sold the lie that there is something deeply wrong with them on account of their queerness. A House and Senate majority is becoming more and more critical by the day. This decision puts Washington’s ban at legal risk. Along with our youth. I will never stop fighting for queer and trans people of all ages. This fight is far from over. – Emily | | Emily Randall is proud to represent Washington’s 6th District in Congress. She grew up in a working-class Union household in Port Orchard and was the first in her family to attend college. After serving in the State Senate and passing nearly 200 bills, Emily made history in 2024 as the first queer Latina elected to Congress. Now, Emily is fighting for WA working families in D.C. and organizing to take back the House. subject: Nothing to joke about
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jon Ossoff for Senate
body:
Happy April Fools! And thank you for all your support!
#

This April Fools Day, the real joke is on our extreme opponents...
Here’s why:
Despite Trump coming to Georgia and personally attacking Jon and Republicans spending millions to defeat him, because of grassroots supporters like you, we were able to meet our fundraising goals and are heading full steam into April. _**Thank you.**_
The support we received will directly translate into more rallies, more ads, more outreach, and more folks across Georgia getting invested in this year's critical Senate race.
We know we send a lot of emails at the end of the month, but every email you read gets us one step closer to reelecting Jon Ossoff in November.
And that’s nothing to joke about!
Thank you,
Ossoff HQ
👋 Wait! Before you go... 👋
Jon Ossoff is facing the most important and competitive Senate race in the nation this year. MAGA has already made him their #1 target and will be looking for any vulnerability to attack him and flip this seat red.
**It is very important that we show Trump, our opponents, and the media that our campaign is fired up and ready to start April strong.**

#### _**Cliff 's Note: **_Right now your edge isn't just anger--it's seeing the pattern.
#### This piece pulls back the curtain on how outrage is manufactured, how stories get buried, and how you're being played in real time. Once you see it, you can't unsee it--and that's exactly why they hope you don't look too closely.
#### If you want more of this--clear-eyed, no-BS analysis that actually connects the dots--**[subscribe today and save 25%](https://substack.com/redirect/4a9d67b9-4116-4cc9-9383-1483c9392c0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[.](https://substack.com/redirect/4a9d67b9-4116-4cc9-9383-1483c9392c0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* * *
_**By David Shuster**_
The MAGA talent for moral indignation, echoed by most conservative media, has always been something to behold. It's like a seedy circus - part spectacle and part absurdity, with carnival barkers on Fox News and elsewhere shouting about sin while quietly pocketing the proceeds. Now, that Trump team circus has returned, pitching its tent across much of the media and political world around Kristi Noem and her husband, Bryon Noem.
The breathless and sensational charge is that Mr. Noem may have indulged in a private life that contradicts the starch collared moral values advertised among the political right.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4a9d67b9-4116-4cc9-9383-1483c9392c0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
Some of us may not understand "cross-dressing" or engage in it. But the most important question in this alleged controversy is, where precisely is the victim?
The answer, so far as the pundits can manage, is that there is none--save perhaps for Kristi Noem. She insists the report about her husband was "shocking" and "devastating."
In turn, ink is being spilled, cable TV panels are convening, and pearls are being clutched across mainstream and social media with vigor.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4a9d67b9-4116-4cc9-9383-1483c9392c0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=192777488&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkyNzc3NDg4LCJpYXQiOjE3NzUwNzkxNzEsImV4cCI6MTc3NzY3MTE3MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.AIU6YSVmlPi-4PhvmrxSM-pYDHkQYzIdox3BoZpD2IQ)
* * *
It's a scandal, we are told, of the highest order. An affront to decency, a collapse of Bryon Noem's character, a veritable Sodom on the prairie.
And still, I can't help but notice that this moral fervor, particularly on the right, is curiously selective.
Because when the conversation turns to the lingering miasma surrounding Jeffrey Epstein and Donald Trump, the temperature across the political and media world drops sharply.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4a9d67b9-4116-4cc9-9383-1483c9392c0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
Jane Doe #4 alleges that Donald Trump raped her in the 1980's when she was an underage teenage girl. In 2019, the FBI considered Jane Doe #4 credible enough to interview her four times. The details about her story that could be confirmed have been confirmed by the FBI and by several independent journalists. Perhaps relatedly, the DOJ continues to withhold 37 pages of documents involving Jane Doe #4.
And yet, because her claims and the assertions of other victims remain "disputed" by Donald Trump and unproven in court, the political and media classes have retreated into a posture of exquisite caution, speaking in hushed tones if they speak at all.
The contrast with Bryon Noem is staggering.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4a9d67b9-4116-4cc9-9383-1483c9392c0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
Noem gets no due process or peace. He violated social expectations, and so we have a mainstream media feeding frenzy. Donald Trump allegedly abused underage girls. Yet with Trump, we continue to get mainstream media silence.
The explanation for this deceitfulness is painfully simple. In the Trump era, the modern machinery of outrage has no fixed principles. It is not animated by justice, nor by compassion, nor even by common sense. It is animated by opportunity. The key issue is usefulness, not wrongdoing.
For months, one of the most talked about "secrets" in Washington, D.C. has been an alleged affair between former DHS secretary Kristi Noem and her chief of staff and former Trump strategist Corey Lewandowski.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4a9d67b9-4116-4cc9-9383-1483c9392c0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=192777488&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkyNzc3NDg4LCJpYXQiOjE3NzUwNzkxNzEsImV4cCI6MTc3NzY3MTE3MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.AIU6YSVmlPi-4PhvmrxSM-pYDHkQYzIdox3BoZpD2IQ)
* * *
Some conservatives defended Noem, insisting her marriage back in South Dakota was "strained."
Now, with the allegations against Bryon Noem, a few of these same conservatives are saying, "see, I told you so. Her marriage was a mess."
And thus, a private Bryon Noem indiscretion--harmless, consensual, and entirely separate from the public interest--is being inflated by some MAGA types into a national emergency because it serves their narrative of the day.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4a9d67b9-4116-4cc9-9383-1483c9392c0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=192777488&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkyNzc3NDg4LCJpYXQiOjE3NzUwNzkxNzEsImV4cCI6MTc3NzY3MTE3MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.AIU6YSVmlPi-4PhvmrxSM-pYDHkQYzIdox3BoZpD2IQ&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
* * *
"Poor Kristi Noem, she was a victim," we are told. Meanwhile, far graver victim allegations against Donald Trump are being handled with the care of a museum curator dusting a fragile relic.
This is not morality. It is theater.
And like all bad theater, it requires a gullible audience willing to suspend disbelief--not in the facts, but in the pretense that the performance is guided by anything resembling principle.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4a9d67b9-4116-4cc9-9383-1483c9392c0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Many consumers of news and politics, while often accused of gullibility, are still shrewd enough though to see through the trick. They recognize that the volume of outrage and shock over Bryon Noem bears no resemblance to the gravity of the offense. They understand that under Trump, the media and political game is rigged, not to conceal sin, but to allocate attention.
In this system, the only truly unforgivable act is to be on the wrong side of the spotlight, and the wrong side of Trump and his sycophants, including Kristi Noem.
In the meantime, the MAGA circus band plays on, the barkers keep barking, and the great Trump team carnival of selective indignation rolls forward, leaving behind not enlightenment nor justice, but only the lingering stench of hypocrisy.

Inside the media's selective outrage machine | | and | Apr 1 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Cliff 's Note: Right now your edge isn't just anger--it's seeing the pattern. This piece pulls back the curtain on how outrage is manufactured, how stories get buried, and how you're being played in real time. Once you see it, you can't unsee it--and that's exactly why they hope you don't look too closely. If you want more of this--clear-eyed, no-BS analysis that actually connects the dots-- By David Shuster The MAGA talent for moral indignation, echoed by most conservative media, has always been something to behold. It's like a seedy circus - part spectacle and part absurdity, with carnival barkers on Fox News and elsewhere shouting about sin while quietly pocketing the proceeds. Now, that Trump team circus has returned, pitching its tent across much of the media and political world around Kristi Noem and her husband, Bryon Noem. The breathless and sensational charge is that Mr. Noem may have indulged in a private life that contradicts the starch collared moral values advertised among the political right. | | ---|---|--- Some of us may not understand "cross-dressing" or engage in it. But the most important question in this alleged controversy is, where precisely is the victim? The answer, so far as the pundits can manage, is that there is none--save perhaps for Kristi Noem. She insists the report about her husband was "shocking" and "devastating." In turn, ink is being spilled, cable TV panels are convening, and pearls are being clutched across mainstream and social media with vigor. | | ---|---|--- It's a scandal, we are told, of the highest order. An affront to decency, a collapse of Bryon Noem's character, a veritable Sodom on the prairie. And still, I can't help but notice that this moral fervor, particularly on the right, is curiously selective. Because when the conversation turns to the lingering miasma surrounding Jeffrey Epstein and Donald Trump, the temperature across the political and media world drops sharply. | | ---|---|--- Jane Doe #4 alleges that Donald Trump raped her in the 1980's when she was an underage teenage girl. In 2019, the FBI considered Jane Doe #4 credible enough to interview her four times. The details about her story that could be confirmed have been confirmed by the FBI and by several independent journalists. Perhaps relatedly, the DOJ continues to withhold 37 pages of documents involving Jane Doe #4. And yet, because her claims and the assertions of other victims remain "disputed" by Donald Trump and unproven in court, the political and media classes have retreated into a posture of exquisite caution, speaking in hushed tones if they speak at all. The contrast with Bryon Noem is staggering. | | ---|---|--- Noem gets no due process or peace. He violated social expectations, and so we have a mainstream media feeding frenzy. Donald Trump allegedly abused underage girls. Yet with Trump, we continue to get mainstream media silence. The explanation for this deceitfulness is painfully simple. In the Trump era, the modern machinery of outrage has no fixed principles. It is not animated by justice, nor by compassion, nor even by common sense. It is animated by opportunity. The key issue is usefulness, not wrongdoing. For months, one of the most talked about "secrets" in Washington, D.C. has been an alleged affair between former DHS secretary Kristi Noem and her chief of staff and former Trump strategist Corey Lewandowski. | | ---|---|--- Some conservatives defended Noem, insisting her marriage back in South Dakota was "strained." Now, with the allegations against Bryon Noem, a few of these same conservatives are saying, "see, I told you so. Her marriage was a mess." And thus, a private Bryon Noem indiscretion--harmless, consensual, and entirely separate from the public interest--is being inflated by some MAGA types into a national emergency because it serves their narrative of the day. | | ---|---|--- "Poor Kristi Noem, she was a victim," we are told. Meanwhile, far graver victim allegations against Donald Trump are being handled with the care of a museum curator dusting a fragile relic. This is not morality. It is theater. And like all bad theater, it requires a gullible audience willing to suspend disbelief--not in the facts, but in the pretense that the performance is guided by anything resembling principle. | | ---|---|--- Many consumers of news and politics, while often accused of gullibility, are still shrewd enough though to see through the trick. They recognize that the volume of outrage and shock over Bryon Noem bears no resemblance to the gravity of the offense. They understand that under Trump, the media and political game is rigged, not to conceal sin, but to allocate attention. In this system, the only truly unforgivable act is to be on the wrong side of the spotlight, and the wrong side of Trump and his sycophants, including Kristi Noem. In the meantime, the MAGA circus band plays on, the barkers keep barking, and the great Trump team carnival of selective indignation rolls forward, leaving behind not enlightenment nor justice, but only the lingering stench of hypocrisy. clean_body: Dear Fellow Patriot, January 6th was 5 years ago... ...but for many J6 prisoners, their nightmare is still ongoing. Despite receiving a pardon from President Trump, these unjustly jailed men and women are still struggling to rebuild their lives after 4 years behind bars. Like Damon Beckley. After four years as a political prisoner, Damon came home to a life that had been completely destroyed. His family's landlord evicted them from their home, forcing his wife and son to live in an apartment with no heat. And Damon's health collapsed in prison after contracting MRSA and later requiring emergency cancer surgery. To make matters worse, Damon, his wife, and their son are now facing eviction and possible homelessness again. Sadly, Damon's story is far too common among J6 prisoners. In just the last 60 days, for help from January 6 families struggling to survive. Unless we can count on your help, we 'll be forced to TURN AWAY some of these desperate families. Like I said, Fellow Patriot... Damon's story is all too common. We recently received a request from Kirstyn Niemela, who spent months living in a camper in a friend's backyard during the freezing New Hampshire winter. Because of the stigma of being labeled a J6er, she has struggled to find stable employment. Now, with odd jobs having dried up during the winter months, she's at risk of losing the truck she depends on for transportation and work. Then there's Benjamen Burlew, who is now two months behind on his mortgage and electric bill after health issues wiped out the family's savings. If they fall any further behind, they could lose the home their children have lived in for 17 years. Five years ago, Damon, Kirstyn, and Benjamen were no different than you or me. They had steady jobs. Loving families. Homes they were proud of. And they believed in President Trump's vision for this nation. But the Far-Left turned them into political prisoners ... because they couldn 't jail all of us. Now these patriots are trying to rebuild their lives from nothing... and many of them simply can't do it alone. Stand in the Gap is their lifeline. That's why Stand in the Gap exists: to provide emergency financial aid, housing assistance, legal support, and medical help to the men and women who sacrificed everything. But we can only respond to these urgent requests with support from patriots like you, Fellow Patriot. Your support helps provide: Emergency financial aid to prevent homelessness Legal defense funds for ongoing civil lawsuits Medical support for J6ers suffering lasting health problems Basic living expenses while families rebuild their lives January 6th is NOT ancient history, Fellow Patriot. For these families, it's a nightmare they're still trying to escape. Without our urgent help, many of them will NOT survive to the next chapter. Stand in the Gap is their LAST lifeline... and that lifeline exists SOLELY because of generous supporters like you. body:
#
Peter —
I am reaching out simply to say thank you.
Less than a month ago, I was honored to become your Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate. Together, we mobilized a record-breaking number of Texans. **More people voted in this Democratic primary than in any other statewide primary in Texas history.**
It’s incredible to look back on all that our movement has accomplished since we launched this underdog campaign 7 months ago. All credit goes to every single person like you who is powering this movement.
I didn’t have the advantages of a prior statewide campaign, or the backing of the DC establishment, or a rolodex full of billionaire mega-donors.
**But this movement has something far more powerful: The people.**
You are the backbone of this campaign.
More than 30,000 volunteers have joined our team.
Tens of thousands of Texans have shown up at our events across the state.
**And after closing the books on our FEC deadline last night, I’m proud to say that there are more than 500,000 people who have chipped in to fuel this movement. That is a mind-blowing number.**
We’ve put the billionaire and corporate mega-donors on notice. We are a threat to their corrupt political system. We are why they are worried.
The fight ahead will be incredibly difficult. But I know that together, this movement has what it takes to win.
I’m really proud of what we’re building here. I hope you are, too.
There’s plenty of hard work ahead. But I’m hopeful.
Something is happening in Texas. Something really special.
James

name: Senator Vincent Hughes
subject: Standing Up for Our Democracy
body:
If you are having trouble viewing this message or would like to share it on a social network, you can [view the message online](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?gpiv=2100171621.172676.500&gen=1).

[](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171621.172676.500&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16867)
**Standing Up for Our Democracy** **_Our democracy is worth fighting for_** __ Senator Hughes recently spoke at the [No Kings March in Philadelphia](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171621.172676.500&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16868) to stand with Pennsylvanians who believe in our democracy, the integrity of our voting system, and three co-equal branches of our government. Our country was built on the belief of Liberty and Justice for All. And as President Obama has said, "Democracy is not a spectator sport." We all need to take action. **This Is What Democracy Looks Like** There's a number of ways you can stand up to authoritarianism and any attempt to erode our democracy: **VOTE!** \- Make sure you are [registered to vote](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171621.172676.500&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16869). Primary Election Day in PA will be on [May 19, 2026](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171621.172676.500&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16870). The General Election will be on [November 3, 2026](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171621.172676.500&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16870). Both are important elections to participate in. Make a plan to VOTE! **Encourage Others to VOTE!** \- Let's get [everyone registered to vote](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171621.172676.500&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16869). Talk to your family, friends, neighbors, and coworkers and make sure they understand how simple it is to cast a vote and make their voice heard. **Educate and Engage with Others - **We are in a time where friends, family, and community members are the best messengers when it comes to getting the word out about issues and solutions that matter. If you care about a cause or something that needs to be fixed, let your people know! **This SAVE Act ** There's been a lot in the news lately about the [SAVE ACT](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171621.172676.500&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16871), a piece of federal legislation designed to make it harder, and in some instances impossible, for American citizens to vote. The claim is that the SAVE Act will stop voter fraud. The truth is that our elections are already fair and secure. In Pennsylvania, [Spotlight PA found](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171621.172676.500&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16872) only 14 instances of voter fraud over 10 years of millions of votes cast. And it is already illegal for non-citizens to vote in federal elections under the Illegal Immigration Reform and Immigrant Responsibility Act of 1996. The good news is that trusted leaders in Pennsylvania, including Governor Shapiro and Secretary Al Schmidt, are keeping a close eye on what's happening in Washington to ensure that PA elections remain free and fair. Local leaders like Commissioner Omar Sabir in Philadelphia and Vice Chair Neil Makhija in Montgomery County are also on top of securing the integrity of our elections. **Get Involved, Don't Give Up** This past weekend's No Kings March showed that Pennsylvania has no interest in tyrannical governments that ignore the will of people. There are a number of ways to stay engaged in this fight and help others understand the importance of this moment. Senator Hughes will continue to fight for our democracy and the integrity of our voting system in every way he can at the state level. We encourage you to stay involved. Don't give up!
* * *
Continue to follow us on [Facebook](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171621.172676.500&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16874), [Instagram](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171621.172676.500&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16860), [TikTok](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171621.172676.500&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16861), [X](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171621.172676.500&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16863), and [BlueSky](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100171621.172676.500&gen=1&mailing_linkid=16864) for the latest news about Senator Hughes' work and what's happening in the 7th Senatorial District.

name: KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION
subject: What "Steady Leadership" Really Means.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY KAREN CRNKOVICH FOR JOHNSON COUNTY COMMISSION * 6709 West 119th Street * Ste
body:
You may have seen the phrase “steady leadership” being used a lot lately....

| | | | | |
---
|
---
| |

Friend,
You may have seen the phrase “steady leadership” being used a lot lately in the communication from Mike Kelly in his re-election campaign.
It sounds good.
But in practice, we need to ask...**steady in what direction?**
Because in Johnson County right now, “steady” has meant something very specific:Steady growth in government spending.
Steady expansion of the county budget.
And steady pressure on taxpayers to keep up.
We’re told revenues aren’t keeping pace with expenses.
But that raises a more important question:**Why are expenses growing so fast in the first place?**
That’s not stability.
That’s a system on autopilot.
And if we don’t change course, it leads somewhere very predictable:
Higher taxes. Bigger government. And fewer questions asked along the way.
_**True leadership isn’t about keeping things exactly as they are.**_
_**It’s about stepping in, asking hard questions, and making responsible decisions before taxpayers are asked to foot the bill.**_
Because Johnson County families don’t get to operate on autopilot.
You have to budget. You have to prioritize. You have to make tough calls.
Your county government should do the same.
That’s the difference in this race.
One approach says: keep things steady and trust the system.
The other says: take a hard look at where we’re headed and fix it now.
I’m running to bring that second approach to Johnson County.
When leaders ask you not to question the direction, it’s usually because they don’t want to defend it.
If you’re ready to be part of a campaign that asks the hard questions and fights for accountability, I’d love to have you on the team.

At VRF, we identify and support champions of democracy, equipping them with the resources they need to protect voters across the country. **Today, we are proud to highlight a previously endorsed champion: Priya Sundareshan.** As State Senator for LD 18, Priya is one of Arizona’s most vocal and effective advocates for voting rights issues in the state. Since 2022, Priya has fought back against election fraud conspiracies and legislative attacks on mail-in ballots. As a legislator, she has sponsored bills to expand and protect voting access, including permanent early voting, automatic voter registration, and privacy protections for election officials. [She also helped introduce the Voters First Act (2026)](http://links.votingrightsfund.org/s/c/uxeSWDeuIZDc2G749nNbna4F-sP6NqN44Ub7eh1TKIeZva9g2eafd6m9Gl4PPuadZX9olqM0z4uf9uGlQOgU5hVAnJz88oC4nQiBBjciUSr_snKNfsLqkHeqjEEPIqeQ9AIsPhgAxuAinU1peCphri08IHRVLvpfa6czVyp-5GQDHfP37QYoCWLlbkzNOA_dOjt-gaaFcBs7L2iCBQV2O2ly70UitjaRgwFgYK7Qz0ZgnSbcRJbrtTcFwn-z74xQt4S0SZhp8bTIS-j6fpuD_rLJ_RYFvh96_YDAsfxtVZuRcAPe3jMpQx3ze990e82waTMotLV4rXHL1RTeL5BmsfJxscLlu2f1czEV6VonFA/KuL4-J_6vzFkxUUy6DLXopwIRWixSRhr/19) a package of commonsense reforms that builds on proven policies to empower voters and improve election administration. Priya has been proudly serving the people of Legislative District 18 since she was first elected in 2022. **In just two years, she rose to Senate Democratic Leader, becoming one of the most influential voices for democracy in a state facing sustained attacks on voting rights.** [](http://links.votingrightsfund.org/s/c/eUcotf-qkQRLwp6a83YppdDjZpSLdDReir6qlbhiIDWlQpiDtlcteRHWA-Y2jKL9RLVrzJ4iqLR92Mf47UosgfmCRFQhLRDE8HOJ5i-uG5tMytePzJt6fnV-l2jVfiIntLl5jzlaSRbZPM55D-cqK4_VR4gZfiDuKC7J0Nws11SzVtJdesc0qfjeDZCr7E5AAwvLb_sKSa_OwrNoDztBzTgEuOtd4ts1Wwc9jxOQqy6bcGz5rYedcU9XYWDR_t7yrxupp5rC0nG1BQyidlzsJCvlRxbzNvsKsdWM7xb375bfsP-X3_f5Mv6EhFb4YdnywOPiW7pq4GWJ7omZ9Xvrovr3DtrGLUN-Zr0Nxm1xhOhszxFvA019gYQiEKURATho5qdApRVlsJ2jGijuNOHbvU0vAVLIdPdOOrRk3VFhq0qumJwReBHxe9Xn6UuA-8aa9Dmo_oXfyrbWY4fVKxw7B2PCi6iGEikKVbNK0MQiIfQORuXLj1yhD7NadC0XYzVd7mc82DOPh6AkQPGnaZvzxNGNSXXw9rnHe1kQoSQWzz0zxFKRjgAB5-kGeMrFzBRx4as6n1NZcufZ2zS8KyqFSS_XIMlR1Kqjtmr18hU27VUwIsip6gK01QG71X0oZXWg36OmospKrzAAtzHhOxqQy0kYum3vrK1O1TXYP6qVULScE--moO2us1Qe8cqrAlqPpzZojU21H_fl1PqUr9Bbok_M9yRJLiRq7nulh6D1ka0dOvYOs3AaZlJamY5N2fK4VkOcT_fuypizZl17RQceY-Mo9tGABMAaRfLZjucTrmYfjOMa2TWbMzt3CLUfXllVKLr6R-M58QeMkty-Y_IlaLFXS0Db7-uZTyuV0r1o2Fh-zYPUWcJHtzoYNovOewX_kR5USM7gmBPEAZUfZxKX/H4AGMg5nqVkQeibZBp9EY0v9cqJmzb8j/19) **Priya Sundareshan in Her Own Words** _Democracy and the rule of law are very important to me as a lawyer, and voting rights were a key reason for why I first ran for office. I have been a voting rights advocate prior to running for the Arizona Legislature in 2022, having volunteered for years in voter protection and serving as the Voter Protection Hotline Director for the Arizona Democratic Party in the 2018 election cycle. I then led the Arizona Democratic Party's Election Integrity Committee and organized party activists to engage with the 2021 redistricting process and to advocate with Congress to pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Act, and with the AZ Legislature against voting rights attacks._ _In the legislature, I made sure that I was immediately added to the Senate Elections Committee to fight back against the constant barrage of voter suppression bills proposed by the Republican majority. I am proud that I was named the Ranking Member of the Senate Elections Committee in just my second year in office and charged with guiding my caucus on voting rights issues. I was instrumental in negotiating legislation in 2024 to address the possibility that our close elections would not be resolved in time to send Arizona's presidential electors to Congress, a bill which was signed into law by Gov. Katie Hobbs without any of the voter-suppressive measures that the Republican majority tried to insert._ _Now as Leader of the Senate Democratic Caucus, I ensure that my entire caucus holds the line against the incessant Republican bills that seek to limit access to the ballot. I am also the co-chair of the Arizona Democratic Legislative Campaign Committee, focused on gaining the majority in both houses of the Legislature in 2026. Once we gain the majority, I look forward to finally putting forward ideas that are more protective of voting rights at the state level (and then passing them into law!), especially as we see Voting Rights Act protections at the federal level under attack._ **Priya’s Voice Matters, Now More than Ever** Arizona’s voting rights are under sustained and increasing attack. Last month, the FBI subpoenaed Maricopa County voting records in yet another search for non-existent voter fraud. The Trump administration continues to push claims of voter fraud, a problem that multiple independent and bipartisan committees and investigations have concluded does not exist in Arizona or in any other state. Just last night, Donald Trump signed an executive order to build a federal voter system, created and owned by the Department of Homeland Security, designed to keep track of eligible voters. The order also restricts mail-in and absentee voting by requiring a separate list of those eligible to use mail-in ballots. clean_body: | | | Hello, Voting Rights Fund is proud to announce our Arizona primary endorsements for the 2026 midterm elections. At VRF, we identify and support champions of democracy, equipping them with the resources they need to protect voters across the country. Today, we are proud to highlight a previously endorsed champion: Priya Sundareshan. As State Senator for LD 18, Priya is one of Arizona’s most vocal and effective advocates for voting rights issues in the state. Since 2022, Priya has fought back against election fraud conspiracies and legislative attacks on mail-in ballots. As a legislator, she has sponsored bills to expand and protect voting access, including permanent early voting, automatic voter registration, and privacy protections for election officials. a package of commonsense reforms that builds on proven policies to empower voters and improve election administration. Priya has been proudly serving the people of Legislative District 18 since she was first elected in 2022. In just two years, she rose to Senate Democratic Leader, becoming one of the most influential voices for democracy in a state facing sustained attacks on voting rights. Priya Sundareshan in Her Own Words Democracy and the rule of law are very important to me as a lawyer, and voting rights were a key reason for why I first ran for office. I have been a voting rights advocate prior to running for the Arizona Legislature in 2022, having volunteered for years in voter protection and serving as the Voter Protection Hotline Director for the Arizona Democratic Party in the 2018 election cycle. I then led the Arizona Democratic Party's Election Integrity Committee and organized party activists to engage with the 2021 redistricting process and to advocate with Congress to pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Act, and with the AZ Legislature against voting rights attacks. In the legislature, I made sure that I was immediately added to the Senate Elections Committee to fight back against the constant barrage of voter suppression bills proposed by the Republican majority. I am proud that I was named the Ranking Member of the Senate Elections Committee in just my second year in office and charged with guiding my caucus on voting rights issues. I was instrumental in negotiating legislation in 2024 to address the possibility that our close elections would not be resolved in time to send Arizona's presidential electors to Congress, a bill which was signed into law by Gov. Katie Hobbs without any of the voter-suppressive measures that the Republican majority tried to insert. Now as Leader of the Senate Democratic Caucus, I ensure that my entire caucus holds the line against the incessant Republican bills that seek to limit access to the ballot. I am also the co-chair of the Arizona Democratic Legislative Campaign Committee, focused on gaining the majority in both houses of the Legislature in 2026. Once we gain the majority, I look forward to finally putting forward ideas that are more protective of voting rights at the state level (and then passing them into law!), especially as we see Voting Rights Act protections at the federal level under attack. Priya’s Voice Matters, Now More than Ever Arizona’s voting rights are under sustained and increasing attack. Last month, the FBI subpoenaed Maricopa County voting records in yet another search for non-existent voter fraud. The Trump administration continues to push claims of voter fraud, a problem that multiple independent and bipartisan committees and investigations have concluded does not exist in Arizona or in any other state. name: Jim Jordan
subject: I’ll never accuse you of abandoning us
body:
After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you, Patriot!
| Patriot,
---
I’m sick of seeing text messages that accuse you of abandoning the GOP after all you’ve done for us.
---
All because you didn’t give $15 before some random deadline, that’s supposed to mean you **_“betrayed”_** the Republican Party and became a Democrat?
---
So all the times you stood in line to vote, you knocked on doors, you put up a yard sign, you made phone calls, you filled out surveys, you sacrificed your time and money – suddenly, all of that means nothing?
---
**_Give me a break! That’s just insulting._**
---
_Hand to God, I will never stoop to that low._
---
Truth be told, I try not to write too many emails and texts as it is. I’m busy working in Washington to do the job you asked me to do.
---
Honestly, fundraising just isn’t Priority #1.
---
At the end of 2024, I transferred $2.5 MILLION _**away**_ from my own campaign to help conservatives in tough races who _truly_ needed help.
---
**You know what I care about most?** The _ONLY_ thing that WINS elections – **_VOTES_**.
---
_That means registering voters, verifying every Trump voter’s profile, and constantly getting LIVE feedback from voters like you so that the President and I _always_ have the best, most accurate data in the country._
---
That’s how we won in 2024. And it’s my plan to win AGAIN in 2026.
---

Trump filed
a case asking the Supreme Court to end birthright citizenship and let him
decide who counts as an American.

Then, at today’s oral arguments, he showed up.
He sat in the room while the justices heard arguments on whether he can
gut the 14th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution.

It’s intimidation — full stop.

A president with a direct stake in the outcome, sitting in the room while
the Court considers handing him sweeping power, is a blatant display of
pressure, and a clear sign of just how far he’s willing to go.

For over a century, birthright citizenship has been settled law. Lower
courts have already said Trump’s executive order stripping this right is
unconstitutional.

He doesn’t care. He wants the Court to override history and hand him the
authority to decide who belongs in this country.

If they succeed, once-guaranteed citizenship and rights would be ripped
from millions of people born in the U.S. — and signal that this Court is
willing to rubber stamp the most extreme abuses of power from a wannabe
authoritarian president.

That’s the reality we’re facing. Demand Justice PAC is taking on this
captured, far-right Court, exposing the corruption, and making clear
exactly what’s at stake for our rights and our democracy. But we can’t win
this fight without you.

[1]Justice Democrats

Hi Peter,

I’m Dr. Adam Hamawy. I was a U.S. Army combat surgeon in Iraq, and also
volunteered on medical missions to help in Sudan, Haiti, Bosnia, Syria,
and Gaza.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260401-ah.T8vG0j&refcode=em20260401-37629&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=37629%2E1203867%2E6mOJd4 ]Dr. Adam Hamawy working as a surgeon

Now, I’m running for Congress in New Jersey’s 12th district because we
should be funding healthcare, not bombs. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260401-ah.T8vG0j&refcode=em20260401-37629&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=37629%2E1203867%2E6mOJd4 ]If you agree, pitch in to
power our campaign.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260401-ah.T8vG0j&refcode=em20260401-37629&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=37629%2E1203867%2E6mOJd4 ]Dr. Adam Hamawy standing with a banner of his name surrounded by
supporters

This week, Justice Democrats officially joined our movement and endorsed
our campaign in NJ-12. I’m so excited to be part of their 2026 slate and
have their support in this competitive Democratic primary race.

After I personally witnessed children blown to pieces in Gaza, I went to
Washington to share what I saw. It wasn’t war; it was genocide.

But too many of the politicians didn’t even want to listen to me. Corrupt
lobbies have bought our government. Those same politicians say that we
can’t afford Medicare for All, but somehow, there’s always enough money
for bombs.

There are others in this race that supported giving billions and billions
to ICE and the genocide in Gaza. They even entertained preemptive strikes
on Iran. That era of the Democratic Party is over — I won’t take a dime
from corporate PACs or AIPAC.

We live in a crisis moment. It’s tax season, and right now, the U.S. is
spending trillions of our tax dollars on an illegal war in Iran. Masked
agents are abducting and killing our neighbors. Everything is absurdly
expensive. And fascists are trying to take over.

It doesn’t have to be this way.

We could win Medicare for All, abolish ICE, and unrig the economy. That’s
what I’ll fight for in Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260401-ah.T8vG0j&refcode=em20260401-37629&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1005&akid=37629%2E1203867%2E6mOJd4 ]This campaign is about you, and I need your help. Join us in the fight:
split a contribution to our movement and Justice Democrats to help us win
this Democratic primary in June.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260401-ah.T8vG0j&refcode=em20260401-37629&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1024&akid=37629%2E1203867%2E6mOJd4 ]Contribute $5

Thank you,

Dr. Adam Hamawy

### **Gallows humor**
Are you worried about [sea level rise](https://substack.com/redirect/e3c7f9bd-16f9-4c74-9a53-c9e5b23786fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
[Crop failures](https://substack.com/redirect/7cd0c16d-a512-4d5a-bb58-b6f68a5c755d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) driven by [climate chaos](https://substack.com/redirect/c9e67c0b-a414-4199-bdc3-b45383f298c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
[Wildfires](https://substack.com/redirect/7ea09b6e-3a91-4cc2-8ccd-9260df689c2b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) driven by unseasonal [heat waves](https://substack.com/redirect/1b012f68-8e3b-4320-9d31-e2106b3b0de4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
[Water shortages](https://substack.com/redirect/a0bfe450-1203-4396-84a0-8ed65a00390e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) due to catastrophically [low snow pack](https://substack.com/redirect/125d547e-d446-4d57-a3e8-0d3ff97c580e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
[Nuclear war](https://substack.com/redirect/84c04d6f-63a4-4fc1-8dc1-831c308b0c40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
[Economic collapse](https://substack.com/redirect/3eee821d-e1bc-4ec6-92d3-058e218678a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
[Fascist goons](https://substack.com/redirect/75c10f09-9973-49ef-aa4d-0dfa3a4c9da8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) showing up at your door?
Don't worry! Whichever among those threats you're most concerned about, one of the others is probably going to get you first.
### **Laugh --if only to keep yourself from crying**
Learning this morning that the U.S. Forest Service is being [dismantled](https://substack.com/redirect/86cf3723-e2ab-4ae8-bc98-da7b235c4c04?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) brought that "joke" to mind.
As [explained](https://open.substack.com/pub/morethanjustparks/p/breaking-trump-administration-orders) by another writer on this platform:
> One hundred and ninety-three million acres of your national forests. An area larger than Texas. The largest public land agency in the country. Just handed, on a silver platter, to the people who've spent their entire careers trying to destroy it.
> And they did it with a press release on a Tuesday.
As a writer challenged by the burden of surviving capitalism as [a working person](https://substack.com/redirect/08188d41-a2ed-4093-9e48-053a3232bfbb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), I must admit to having been increasingly overwhelmed by recent events. I've started half a dozen half-finished drafts of articles exploring various intersecting crises, but struggled to wade through the various nuances they each present.
I'll try to bring each of them to a rational conclusion in the coming weeks, but needed to share the joke above in case it might offer levity.
We could all use some of that, I think.

I wish the news about the Forest Service were an April fools joke. But, in all honesty, the looming future is the furthest thing from funny.

I'm running the Boston Marathon on April 20th. It will be my first road marathon ever.
I've run seven marathons and ultras, all in the mountains. But I've watched Boston on TV dreamed about that finish line on Boylston Street. Now I'm going to find out what it feels like.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7a4b2c28-0495-4797-a428-2ba8c081728f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

photo by Adam Clark
I found running when I was going through something I didn't know how to talk about. Someone was harassing me online for years, calling me a glacier killer, leaving voicemails during Thanksgiving dinner, telling me there would be celebrations when I ended up like my friend Liz, who died in an avalanche.
Running was the only thing that made my nervous system settle. Something about the pitter patter of my feet on the ground, the wind in my face, the simple act of moving my body forward. Ten minutes and I felt like a different person.
**So on April 20th, I 'm running 26.2 miles for the climate, the very thing people harassed me for caring about.**
This winter was hard to witness. Utah's snowpack sat at roughly half of normal. Resorts opened terrain late and closed early. The mountains I've built my life around are changing, visibly, season by season.

It will be my first road marathon ever. I've run seven marathons and ultras, all in the mountains. But I've watched Boston on TV dreamed about that finish line on Boylston Street. Now I'm going to find out what it feels like. | | ---|---|--- photo by Adam Clark I found running when I was going through something I didn't know how to talk about. Someone was harassing me online for years, calling me a glacier killer, leaving voicemails during Thanksgiving dinner, telling me there would be celebrations when I ended up like my friend Liz, who died in an avalanche. Running was the only thing that made my nervous system settle. Something about the pitter patter of my feet on the ground, the wind in my face, the simple act of moving my body forward. Ten minutes and I felt like a different person. So on April 20th, I 'm running 26.2 miles for the climate, the very thing people harassed me for caring about. This winter was hard to witness. Utah's snowpack sat at roughly half of normal. Resorts opened terrain late and closed early. The mountains I've built my life around are changing, visibly, season by season. I'm running as part of the B.A.A. Climate Crew. name: API PA
subject: Take Action With Us! | April Newsletter
body:
https://www.apipennsylvania.org [https://www.apipennsylvania.org]
Hi Peter,
My name is Christopher Ratliff and I am a Civic Engagement Organizer with API PA. My mother is an immigrant from Taiwan and worked hard to provide for me and my siblings in Allegheny County.
Growing up, there weren’t a lot of people in my community who looked like me or my family. It felt lonely and isolating — like our voices didn’t matter — even as we faced similar problems as many of our neighbors. It didn’t seem like the people in power cared about us. I’ve heard similar stories from our communities all over Pennsylvania, and that’s why I’m working to build power with API PA.
Not everyone knows this, but there is an election this year. Over the past few years, our communities have been under attack by the federal government, whether it’s with ICE agents in our streets or the proposed anti-voter bills that will make it harder for us to register to vote. This election, we have a chance to protect our communities, and elect champions that will stand with us. It is so important to make sure our communities are registered to vote, and that we are ready to be heard at the polls.
We need to protect our families, our communities, and our well-being, and we can do this by voting this year. My mom moved here from Taiwan to give my family a better life. I'm working hard to make sure my siblings have opportunities, and my community can be safe. In 2024, I led a team in Allegheny that knocked over 100,000 doors to make sure everyone had what they needed in order to vote. Last year in Allegheny County alone, we helped over 1000 people register to vote.
You can help hold the people in power accountable for their decisions and how they impact our day-to-day lives by checking your voter registration and making sure you are ready to vote on May 17th! [https://vote.pa/?org=apipa]
In solidarity,
Christopher Ratliff
Civic Engagement Organizer | Allegheny County
Asian Pacific Islander Political Alliance (API PA)
API PA is endorsing candidates!
Over weeks of interviews and deliberation, API PA members voted on their final slate of endorsements! We are supporting candidates running in races across the commonwealth who stand in solidarity with our communities, and who will fight for all Pennsylvanians to live with security, dignity, and opportunity.
Last year every API PA-endorsed candidate secured victory in races throughout the state. This year, we’re excited and prepared to do it again!
Check out our endorsed candidates [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/candidates]

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. Friends, today was a critical milestone in our fight to defend birthright citizenship in the Supreme Court, and I want to share an update with you on where we stand:
This morning, the Supreme Court heard oral arguments in Trump v. Barbara , a case that was brought by a class of children who would lose their citizenship under Donald Trump’s executive order ending birthright citizenship.
I want to be clear about what’s at stake: if Trump’s unlawful executive order is allowed to stand, hundreds of thousands of children born each year would be stripped of their ability to fully and fairly participate in our society as American citizens.
They would lose their most basic rights guaranteed by the Constitution.
Birthright citizenship is foundational to American democracy. It's the promise that any child born here is equal under American law, regardless of race, class, creed, or parental background — and it’s a guarantee that every child born here has a personal stake in the American dream.
It tells you something that on the very first day of his second term, Trump attempted to strike down this fundamental and longstanding right with an executive order — a right guaranteed by the 14th Amendment, and the rule that has governed our nation for more than 150 years.
I sued him within hours. Lower courts repeatedly issued nationwide injunctions blocking his order from taking effect, and every court to consider this question has rejected Trump's unlawful overreach.
But Trump hasn't given up — and neither have we.
In February, I co-led a coalition of 24 attorneys general in filing an amicus brief defending the children who would lose their citizenship under Trump's order. And today, we brought that fight to the highest court in the land.
After listening to oral arguments this morning, I'm optimistic. The text of the Constitution and more than a century of legal precedent are clear — and I believe Trump’s attempt to undermine the rights of millions will fail.
If you agree that every child born in this country is a rightful citizen, add your name right now to show your support for our fight at the Supreme Court. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/JXo0SqWm8kCt8qrf-CVSEQ2]
SIGN YOUR NAME [https://secure.ngpvan.com/JXo0SqWm8kCt8qrf-CVSEQ2]
This fight isn't over until the Court rules. But we've beaten Trump on this at every turn, and I intend to keep it that way.
Thanks for standing with me. I'll keep you updated as soon as we hear more.
—Rob

subject: The race for Treasurer changed on Saturday (with a behind-the-scenes timeline!)
body:
The results of Saturday’s State Assembly surpassed even our campaign’s high ambitions

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/37e726d1686f/get-more-smarter-on-colorados-budget-10374903?e=b48bb2b4f4)
---
[|
---](https://bridgesforcolorado.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba078768558df9fe7d8559d49&id=a2adf5d0e0&e=b48bb2b4f4)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi there,
Jeff’s wife AnnMarie here, writing with a major campaign update. The results of Saturday’s State Assembly – where Democrats from across the state came together – surpassed even our campaign’s high ambitions.
**A room full of the most engaged Democrats in Colorado settled on Jeff as the only candidate to advance to the primary, making him the Democratic nominee to be Colorado’s next State Treasurer**.
It’s the most headline-worthy outcome from Saturday’s vote, where Jeff was the only frontrunner who managed to keep other candidates from advancing. That means even the candidates for Governor, Attorney General, and Secretary of State who took home high percentages this weekend have to battle it out again in June’s statewide primary, before heading to the general.
---
[|
---](https://bridgesforcolorado.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba078768558df9fe7d8559d49&id=b5547a8301&e=b48bb2b4f4)
| |
Jeff’s conclusive victory means he’ll appear alone on the Democratic primary ballot – so we can turn our attention to the general starting now. (Ok, maybe starting in a few days after we’ve recovered from all the excitement.)
You can read all the details from the Colorado Sun [here](https://bridgesforcolorado.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba078768558df9fe7d8559d49&id=54681b8108&e=b48bb2b4f4).
Saturday was exhausting and exhilarating. Here’s a behind-the-scenes timeline of our campaign’s most pivotal day:
**7:46 am** \- Kit crushing breakfast at the Holiday Inn Express Pueblo before we head to the assembly location, Pueblo’s Memorial Hall. Jeff and the moms (his and mine) are already there!

**8:28 am** \- G-pa Gerry comes out to take Kit in so he can skip the line – I’ll be waiting in the queue wrapped around the building to get my credentials so I can cast my vote for Jeff as an Arapahoe County delegate.

**9:02 am** \- Team Bridges works our table in the main hall, where we’re passing out t-shirts and wristbands so our most enthusiastic supporters can join us on stage later.

**9:20 am** \- As delegates filter in, we get to greet some of the new supporters we met across the last month of dedicated outreach (by foot, phone, text, and mail!) to the ~1300 delegates. And, of course, get them outfitted with the interactive campaign buttons I designed!

**9:48 am** \- Jeff and his mom Barbara greet former State Treasurer Cary Kennedy, who made the long drive to Pueblo to offer an extremely impactful 30-second nomination on Jeff’s behalf.

**10:10 am** \- After hours of waiting around, Kit takes to amusing himself on campaign signage.

**10:57 am** \- Jeff takes the stage with 50+ campaign supporters wearing t-shirts and waving signs. We were so moved to have supporters from across the state, some of whom were with us in Jeff’s very first campaign (hi CJ!), as well as some of Jeff’s dearest colleagues from the Capitol like Senate President James Coleman, President Pro Temp Kathy Kipp, former State Rep. Barbara McLachlan, and current colleague and Chair on the Joint Budget Committee State Rep. Emily Sirota.
****
**11:01 am** \- Jeff lays out a vision for using the Treasurer’s office to address Colorado’s urgent fiscal crisis, pledging to bring the state’s resources home and put them to work here, investing Colorado dollars in Colorado.

**12:03 pm** \- Kit completely slept through the excitement on stage.

**12:40 pm** \- As the candidate speeches proceed (14 in total!), Kit explores backstage.
**1:55 pm** \- As official voting begins, Jeff catches up with his other official nominator, House Majority Leader Monica Duran.

**2:12 pm** \- As we wait for the votes to be tallied, the delegation approves the state party platform.

**2:52 pm** \- Kit is not the only one who is antsy as the credentials committee, who review the votes to ensure all rules are followed, takes extra time to review the results. He amuses the security guards by running his firetruck up and down the hallway.

**3:32 pm** \- Jeff’s incredible victory is announced! Jeff (with Kit in his arms) shares a delighted hug with our starpower campaign manager, Michael Stella.

**3:36 pm** \- We take a celebratory family picture from the stage as the delegates file out.
****
**3:40 pm** \- Jeff and Kit join State Party Chair Shad Murib to sign the paperwork officially accepting his spot on the June primary ballot.

Saturday was a wild high in a wild ride. Next we take the fight where it belongs – against Trump and TABOR’s attacks on Colorado’s state finances. Stay tuned for updates about how Jeff will be using this singular opportunity!
---

P.S. Right after his victory, Jeff went directly back to the legislature to close the 2026 state budget!

**But thanks to Senate Democrats’ relentless fight, we’re inches away from DESTROYING this bill for good — and SAVING voting rights!**

[**We’re calling on EVERY supporter reading this to join the fight and THANK Senate Democrats for defending our democracy »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/106133?t=7&akid=23446%2E878179%2EnRBgjE) | [**THANK SENATE DEMOCRATS: DONATE $3 TO SIGN »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/106133?t=8&akid=23446%2E878179%2EnRBgjE)

FROM: A grateful Democrat

**Thank you for fighting TIRELESSLY against Trump’s disgusting SAVE Act that would disenfranchise married women, target poll workers, and destroy vote-by-mail.**

This is true heroism — and exactly the kind of leadership we need to defeat Republicans’ disgusting attacks on the American people!

It’s clear: Trump wouldn’t be doing this if he wasn’t TERRIFIED. He KNOWS Democrats are on track to end his MAGA trifecta in November.
